title: Thanksgiving Multiplication Bingo 3rd 4th Grade, 30 Different Cards, Multiplication Facts Game, Printable Classroom Math Activity
description:
Multiplication facts practice your class will actually ask to play. Turkey Times Bingo gives you 30 different bingo cards and 30 calling cards for the multiplication facts 2 through 9, ready to print for a Thanksgiving week math block, a center, or a fun Friday.

WHAT'S INSIDE (2 PDFs: 22 pages in colour + the same 22 pages in a low-ink version)
- 30 different bingo cards, 2 to a page (no two cards are alike)
- 30 calling cards with one multiplication fact each (2 through 9)
- Calling checklist and full answer key, so you can check a winner in seconds
- Teacher guide with 4 ways to play (five in a row, four corners, picture frame, blackout)
- Easier and harder options for mixed classes
- Low-ink version of every page

Every card uses the same 30 answers in a different order, so every card can win and every call matters to every player. Each answer appears on only one calling card, so a square never matches two calls. All 30 facts and all 30 cards were checked by code before this listing went live.

GRADE AND SKILL
Grades 3 and 4: fluent multiplication within 100 (3.OA.C.7) and fact review for 4th grade.

GOOD TO KNOW
- US Letter size. Print the colour version or the low-ink version on any home or school printer.
- Cut the calling cards once and keep them; slide bingo cards into sheet protectors to reuse them.
- Digital download: nothing will be shipped. After purchase, download the PDFs from your Etsy Purchases page.

LICENSE
Personal and single-classroom use only: one teacher, one classroom (or one homeschool family). Please do not share the files, post them online or resell them.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
